purpose: Teach: 爐/駝/實/濤/鵬/鮖/鵝/蛎

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、工場の爐、つまり加熱炉の安全点検を徹底しろ
lines.en: I want this company's factory furnaces — the heating equipment — inspected thoroughly for safety.
lines.style: Authoritative, measured pace. Sharp attack on the command. Each phrase distinct. No negotiation in the tone. The weight of responsibility clear but not ponderous.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中東向け商品開発に駝、つまりラクダの図柄を採用します
lines.en: Understood. For the Middle Eastern product line, we'll incorporate camel imagery into the design.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation. Crisp articulation of the task. Steady, professional pace. No hesitation — the plan is already forming as he speaks. Efficient without being rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社名に旧字「實」、つまり実を残せ
lines.en: Keep the old-form character 實 — the traditional 'substance' — in the company name.
lines.style: Decisive instruction. Slight emphasis on 'substance' as though preserving something valuable. Calm, unhurried. This is principle, not preference. A beat to let it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の怒濤、つまり大濤の様な変動に備えます
lines.en: Yes. We'll prepare for market volatility — those sudden, sweeping waves of change.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Slight rise in intensity on 'prepare' — he understands the stakes. Thoughtful pacing, as if working through the challenge even as he speaks. No false confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、鵬の様に視野を広く持って事業を展開しろ
lines.en: Expand the business with the vision of a roc — broad perspective, far sight.
lines.style: Inspirational without theatricality. Slow, deliberate delivery. The image settles in as he speaks. Firm but not harsh. This is an ideal, not a rebuke.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方の鮖、つまりカジカ漁業との提携を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll advance partnerships with local kajika fish operations in the regions.
lines.style: Eager uptake of the vision. Clean, purposeful delivery. A slight warmth entering — he sees the opportunity. Pace picks up slightly, showing engagement with the bigger picture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ブランドロゴに鵝、つまりガチョウの図柄を入れろ
lines.en: Add goose imagery to the company logo — it should be unmistakable in the brand.
lines.style: Clear directive, delivered without doubt. Slight weight on 'unmistakable' — this is a visible commitment. Steady rhythm. Authority wrapped in clarity rather than volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧字「蛎」、つまり牡蠣事業の海外展開を進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll push forward with international expansion of the oyster business — the traditional form, true foundations.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Voice carries closure but also continuation. Steady, grounded. A slight lift at the end suggesting momentum building. Professional but not distant — he's with the vision.
